import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import io
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker

# Prepare the data
csv_data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# Set a professional and visually appealing style
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", context="talk")

# Create the figure and axes for the plot
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 9))

# Create a bubble chart to visualize multiple dimensions
# X-axis: Price, Y-axis: Megapixels, Bubble Size: Max ISO, Color: Brand, Style: Body Type
scatter = sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='price_usd',
    y='megapixels',
    size='max_iso',
    hue='brand',
    style='body_type',
    sizes=(300, 3000),  # Define the range of bubble sizes for better differentiation
    palette='magma',
    alpha=0.8,
    edgecolor='black',
    linewidth=1.5,
    ax=ax
)

# --- Annotations and Plot Enhancements ---

# Add informative labels to each bubble
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    ax.text(
        row['price_usd'],
        row['megapixels'] + 1.5, # Position text above the bubble
        f"{row['brand']} '{str(row['model_year'])[-2:]}\n{row['sensor_type']}",
        fontdict={'size': 10, 'weight': 'semibold'},
        ha='center', # Horizontal alignment
        va='bottom'  # Vertical alignment
    )

# Set a clear title and axis labels
ax.set_title('Camera Market Snapshot: Price vs. Performance', fontsize=22, weight='bold', pad=20)
ax.set_xlabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=16, labelpad=15)
ax.set_ylabel('Megapixels (MP)', fontsize=16, labelpad=15)

# Format the x-axis to display currency
formatter = mticker.FormatStrFormatter('$%.0f')
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(formatter)
plt.xticks(rotation=30, ha='right')
plt.yticks(fontsize=12)

# Improve readability by slightly expanding plot limits
ax.set_xlim(0, df['price_usd'].max() * 1.1)
ax.set_ylim(0, df['megapixels'].max() * 1.15)

# Customize and position the legend outside the plot area for clarity
ax.legend(bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left', borderaxespad=0., title='Legend')

# Ensure all elements fit within the final saved image
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 0.85, 1])

# Save the visualization to a file
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300)
